title: The Sandcastle Row
story: Sandcastle Saturday brought out every bucket in Thimble Harbor. Four builders worked in one row running out from the pier; Teddy photographed his own turrets from six angles, and Mabel's moat came with a sign, correctly punctuated. The judges' sheet numbers the castles from the pier outward, with no names at all, and the tide is on its way in. Who built which castle?
